stemMd: Which model is better supported by comparing the25cm and100cm results?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Neither model, because the observed period falls as length increases.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Model B, because quadrupling length approximately doubles period

options.label: C
options.textMd: Model A, because quadrupling length doubles period.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Both models make the same prediction for those lengths.

explanationMd: Length increases by a factor4 while period increases from1.0 to2.0s, a factor2. The square-root model predicts sqrt4=2.

distractorRationale.c: Direct proportionality would predict a fourfold period.
